tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Your plan, the account-wide AI prompt budget, remaining API quota, and plan entitlements. Call this first: it is how you budget before acting instead of discovering caps as a 402.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The category values accepted when submitting a site or filtering discovery (32 values, max 3 per site).

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: All websites on your account with current metrics: DR, TrueDR, weekly/monthly changes, traffic, referring domains, verification state.

tools.name: submit_site
tools.description: List a new website on VerifiedDR, owned by your account. Use the primary domain (example.com, not blog.example.com). Owned submits count against the free-tier unverified-site cap.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: One site with DR and traffic history plus latest backlink totals. Resolves your own sites first, then falls back to any approved public site (`owned` says which).

tools.name: get_truedr
tools.description: TrueDR (DR weighted by trust and real traffic) for one of YOUR sites, from the stored score. With detailed=true also returns the per-signal trust breakdown and recommended actions — the only place that breakdown is exposed.

tools.name: export_site
tools.description: Machine-readable export for one of your sites: current metrics, the full public authority payload, and badge snippets in one response.

tools.name: lookup_site
tools.description: Public authority lookup for ANY approved site: DR, TrueDR, trust score, confidence, traffic validation, and latest backlink evidence. Never returns owner data.

tools.name: get_trust_map
tools.description: The public Trust Map (backlink map) for any approved site, from cache: per-domain DR, link type, importance, spam score. Answers 503 if no cached map exists yet.

tools.name: get_badge_snippets
tools.description: Ready-to-paste badge and embed snippets (HTML, markdown, share text) plus public links (badge, OG image, sparkline) for any approved site.

tools.name: monitor_sites
tools.description: Authority watch across your sites: weekly (or daily) change digest with traffic validation and spam/trust alerts. Optionally restrict to one site.

tools.name: verify_site
tools.description: Fetch one of your sites and check the VerifiedDR badge is embedded. Side effect: marks the site verified or unverified based on the result.

tools.name: find_sites
tools.description: Discover approved sites by authority for partner/sponsor/integration prospecting, ranked by TrueDR then DR. Verified-only by default.

tools.name: find_partner_opportunities
tools.description: Partner candidates for one of your sites: verified sites worth contacting, excluding anyone you already contacted or dismissed. Use contact_partner to reach out.

tools.name: contact_partner
tools.description: Send a partnership request to one discovered candidate, as the account owner. SENDS REAL EMAIL — always preview with dryRun=true and get the user's approval before sending. Subject and message must be human-quality; there is no template fallback. Monthly contact limits apply per plan.

tools.name: keyword_difficulty
tools.description: The DR profile of the live Google top 10 for a keyword: median DR needed, the weakest ranking domain (entry point), and — with your domain — your gap and a verdict. Paid plans only (402 otherwise).

tools.name: keyword_suggestions
tools.description: Winnable keywords a domain already ranks 4-30 for, ordered by traffic value, brand queries filtered out. Works for any domain (competitor research). Paid plans only.

tools.name: list_tracked_keywords
tools.description: Tracked keyword targets for one of your sites with stored difficulty snapshots (median DR, gap, tier, volume, positions) and 28-day GSC impressions when connected. Free on every plan.

tools.name: add_tracked_keyword
tools.description: Add a keyword target to one of your sites and snapshot its difficulty. Per-site keyword cap applies.

tools.name: refresh_tracked_keyword
tools.description: Re-snapshot a saved keyword target's difficulty.

tools.name: remove_tracked_keyword
tools.description: Remove a tracked keyword target.

tools.name: get_ai_visibility
tools.description: How often ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode name one of your sites for its tracked questions: score, per-question answers, rival brands, cited pages worth outreach, and run history. Reading never spends budget.

tools.name: diff_ai_visibility_runs
tools.description: Compare two stored AI visibility runs: score delta, gained/lost mentions, new/dropped cited sources, brands that entered or left. Run timestamps come from get_ai_visibility history.

tools.name: run_ai_visibility_scan
tools.description: Ask the tracked questions across AI engines NOW. Paid plans only, one run per site per week (inside the cooldown you quietly get the stored run back). This spends real vendor budget — check account_usage first.

tools.name: add_ai_visibility_prompt
tools.description: Add one question to a site's AI visibility tracking (8-300 chars; must not name your own brand/domain). Counts against the account-wide prompt budget. Non-global locations need a paid plan.

tools.name: import_ai_visibility_prompts
tools.description: Import several questions at once (bad lines are skipped, so a pasted numbered list works). Counts against the account-wide prompt budget.

tools.name: set_ai_visibility_prompt_location
tools.description: Pin one tracked question to a country market. Paid plans only.

tools.name: reorder_ai_visibility_prompts
tools.description: Reorder the tracked questions; pass every prompt id in the new order.

tools.name: reset_ai_visibility_prompts
tools.description: Throw away the current question set and reseed from the site's keywords. Paid plans only. Destructive: the old questions are gone.

tools.name: remove_ai_visibility_prompt
tools.description: Delete one tracked question by its prompt id.

tools.name: get_growth_plan
tools.description: The generated growth task plan for one of your sites: ranked tasks with impact, status, and execution artifacts, plus benchmark sites. Free plans get the summary and one revealed action.

tools.name: run_growth_plan
tools.description: Generate a fresh growth plan. Paid plans only. Progress on unchanged tasks carries over, so a re-run never reopens finished work.

tools.name: update_growth_task
tools.description: Move one growth task's status after executing it.

tools.name: get_gsc_audit
tools.description: The latest stored Google Search Console index audit for one of your sites (needs a connected GSC property).

tools.name: run_gsc_audit
tools.description: Run a fresh index audit. Spends real GSC URL Inspection quota; 12h cooldown between runs.

tools.name: get_gsc_performance
tools.description: Search Console performance for one of your sites: totals vs the preceding period, daily data, and top query/page/country/device snapshots from the existing sync.

tools.name: marketplace_packages
tools.description: Backlink Packages on offer, priced for this account (plan discount applied), with the exact websites each package places on.

tools.name: marketplace_sites
tools.description: Single-website listings — buy one placement on one website — ranked with your niches first. Each row's websiteId is what marketplace_cart_add_site takes.

tools.name: marketplace_cart
tools.description: Your current open marketplace cart.

tools.name: marketplace_cart_add_package
tools.description: Add a Backlink Package to the cart. Prices are re-derived server-side; the cart caps at 5 rows.

tools.name: marketplace_cart_add_site
tools.description: Add a single-website placement to the cart.

tools.name: marketplace_cart_remove
tools.description: Remove one row from the cart by its index.

tools.name: marketplace_cart_checkout
tools.description: Start checkout: returns a Stripe Checkout URL and charges NOTHING. A human opens the URL and enters the card — that boundary is deliberate. Give the URL to the user.

tools.name: marketplace_orders
tools.description: Every marketplace order with its placements, their status, and live URLs as publishers deliver. An unbriefed paid order is the thing to chase.

tools.name: marketplace_order_brief
tools.description: Brief a paid order so publishers can start (the brief is collected after payment on purpose).

tools.name: marketplace_requests
tools.description: What one of your websites is asking other websites for (the Ask side of the marketplace).

tools.name: marketplace_request_post
tools.description: Post what your website wants from others and what you'll pay (or pass id to edit an existing ask). Requires a verified website.

tools.name: marketplace_request_remove
tools.description: Take a posted ask down.

tools.name: earn_sites
tools.description: Every owned website with what it earns per placement, whether it's in the publisher network, and its terms.

tools.name: earn_join_network
tools.description: Join the publisher network with one verified website. REFUSES to run without acceptTerms=true, because joining accepts the publisher terms on the owner's behalf — confirm with the user first. Lands in pending for human approval.

tools.name: earn_update_settings
tools.description: Tune a network website's placement settings: link types, turnaround, monthly cap.

tools.name: earn_set_status
tools.description: Set a network website's status: active, paused (stops new work without leaving), or removed (leaves the network).

tools.name: earn_assignments
tools.description: Placements assigned to your websites — target URL, anchor, the buyer's brief, payout, deadline.

tools.name: earn_accept_assignment
tools.description: Accept an assigned placement.

tools.name: earn_decline_assignment
tools.description: Decline an assigned placement (declining is free and expected).

tools.name: earn_submit_live_url
tools.description: Report a placement live — the server fetches the URL and checks the link is actually present before marking it verified. This is what gets you paid.

tools.name: earn_earnings
tools.description: What your websites have earned as publishers (USD cents): pending, due, paid, and the payout threshold.

tools.name: inbox_list
tools.description: Partnership conversations with the unread count. Time-sensitive human work: summarize and draft, don't answer on your own.

tools.name: inbox_thread
tools.description: One partnership conversation: its messages, the website on each side, and any deal attached.

tools.name: inbox_reply
tools.description: Reply in a partnership thread. SENDS REAL EMAIL to the other side, as the account owner — draft and send only on the user's word.

tools.name: inbox_mark_read
tools.description: Mark a partnership thread as read.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_badge_snippets, contact_partner, inbox_list, inbox_mark_read · Private data: contact_partner · Public sink: submit_site, get_badge_snippets, contact_partner, marketplace_request_post, earn_submit_live_url, inbox_reply · Destructive: remove_tracked_keyword, get_ai_visibility, diff_ai_visibility_runs, run_ai_visibility_scan, reset_ai_visibility_prompts, remove_ai_visibility_prompt, run_growth_plan, run_gsc_audit, marketplace_cart_remove, marketplace_request_remove, earn_join_network.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_badge_snippets, contact_partner, inbox_list, inbox_mark_read · Private data: contact_partner · Public sink: submit_site, get_badge_snippets, contact_partner, marketplace_request_post, earn_submit_live_url, inbox_reply · Destructive: remove_tracked_keyword, get_ai_visibility, diff_ai_visibility_runs, run_ai_visibility_scan, reset_ai_visibility_prompts, remove_ai_visibility_prompt, run_growth_plan, run_gsc_audit, marketplace_cart_remove, marketplace_request_remove, earn_join_network

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
